arguments.code:
access_token = resp['access_token']

# Collect song IDs from all playlists in playlist library
all_song_ids = set()
playlist_song_counts = []
for p in all_playlists:
    song_ids = p.get('song_ids', []) or []
    playlist_song_counts.append((p['playlist_id'], p.get('title'), len(song_ids)))
    for sid in song_ids:
        all_song_ids.add(sid)

print('playlist_song_counts', playlist_song_counts)
print('total_unique_song_ids', len(all_song_ids))

# Determine indie-genre songs and collect their artists
indie_song_ids = []
target_artist_ids = set()
indie_song_artists = {}  # sid -> list of artist ids

for sid in sorted(all_song_ids):
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre = song.get('genre', '') or ''
    is_indie = ('indie' in str(genre).lower())
    if is_indie:
        indie_song_ids.append(sid)
        artist_ids = [a['id'] for a in song.get('artists', [])]
        indie_song_artists[sid] = artist_ids
        for aid in artist_ids:
            target_artist_ids.add(aid)

print('indie_song_count', len(indie_song_ids))
print('target_artist_count', len(target_artist_ids))

# Print a verification sample of indie songs
sample_n = 20
print('indie_song_samples', [
    (sid, apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid).get('title'), (apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid).get('genre', ''))) 
    for sid in indie_song_ids[:sample_n]
])

# Check following status and follow missing artists
artists_to_follow = []
for aid in sorted(target_artist_ids):
    following_resp = apis.spotify.show_artist_following(artist_id=aid, access_token=access_token)
    following = following_resp.get('following', False)
    if not following:
        artists_to_follow.append(aid)

print('artists_already_following', len(target_artist_ids) - len(artists_to_follow))
print('artists_to_follow_count', len(artists_to_follow))

# Follow artists
follow_results = []
for aid in artists_to_follow:
    # avoid redundant calls by not refetching name; follow_artist expects id
    r = apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=aid, access_token=access_token)
    follow_results.append((aid, r))

print('follow_results_count', len(follow_results))
print('follow_results_sample', follow_results[:10])
